findings.summary: deleteStaleCliHooks runs before every kickstart and deletes every repository hook named cli, so a second machine's live forwarder hook on the same repository would be cut off (up to 3 attempts per 60 minutes). Availability side effect only; webhook up already does the same. Could restrict deletion to when the log tail shows Hook already exists, or match config.url.
